affinity.notes: Bone, metal, and cloth define the body; no dominant elemental construction is present.

anatomy.notes: Readable humanoid skeleton, sword arm, and trophy-bearing off-hand.

archetype.notes: Melee commander does not communicate the intended bone-levy interceptor duty.

finish.notes: Cohesive bone, iron, and tattered-cloth treatment.

framing.notes: Full silhouette is centered with ample breathing room.

identity.notes: Crowned skeletal knight identifies the Bone Knight form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
